strings.Every monitor re-runs an audit you alrea: Every monitor re-runs an audit you already ran, on your machine, at the interval you set. To add one, open a run in History and choose Schedule as monitor — then set its interval here and switch it on. When the risk crosses your threshold or gets worse than last time, zing alerts your webhooks (Slack / Feishu / DingTalk / generic JSON).
strings.Finish setup to switch it on: Finish setup to switch it on
strings.Pick a run in History and schedule it as: Pick a run in History and schedule it as a monitor →
strings.The configuration comes from the run in: The configuration comes from the run in History. Set how often it runs, then activate it.
strings.History never stores the key. Leave it e: History never stores the key. Leave it empty for a local or self-hosted model.
